numeric_budget_policy: v1 caps unchanged; abort repair reuses remaining per-class slots; independent predicate jobs have separate original six slots
small_cone_policy: only if joint cone exceeds limits; structural branch order; charged to same candidate sweep budget; model requires full original replay and both checkers
attempt_start: base input; no candidate hints; no protected site; free inputs; empty pinned/targets; same predicate; engine-defined order and allowance
attempt_key_binding: base input and empty hints/start encoded in key version
same original repair allowance and order
attempt_cache_policy: Never memoize attempts containing solver unknown/timeout/tool error. Preserve full value-free RepairRecord, source request ID and record hash.
solver_response_policy: Unexpected nonzero exit is tool_error; accept only z3 exit 1 caused solely by a requested but unavailable model after unsat/unknown. Require exact model wire coverage.
application_policy: Enforce pinned main inputs, protected candidate site and hub input restrictions again at concrete model application.
